## T11b Loading · Progress & states

## T11c Motion · Presence & order — `src/motion`

- [x] Transition — fade, slide, scale, collapse → `motion::Transition` fades, rises and slides; collapse is `layout::Collapsible`; scale is blocked: gpui transforms only svgs
- [x] AnimatePresence → `motion::AnimatePresence`
- [x] Motion → gpui's `with_animation`, timed by `motion::duration` and eased by the curves in `motion`
- [x] Spring → `motion::spring`
- [x] Stagger → `motion::Stagger`
- [x] Reorder → `motion::Reorder`
- [x] Flip → `motion::Flip`
- [x] CountUp → `typography::AnimatedNumber`, counting up

## T11d Motion · Effects

- [x] Marquee → `motion::Marquee`
- [x] Ripple → `motion::Ripple`
- [x] Confetti → `motion::Confetti`
- [x] Glow / Pulse → `motion::Glow`, `motion::Pulse`
- [x] Blink / Flash → `motion::Blink`, `motion::Flash`
- [x] Shake → `motion::Shake`
- [x] ParticleBackground → `motion::ParticleBackground`
- [x] AnimatedGradient — slow tonal drift → `motion::AnimatedGradient`
- [x] Lottie Player — blocked: gpui paints paths without the clip masks, mattes, blend modes and radial gradients Lottie files lean on, so frames would come out wrong
